description:
This bundle exports org.apache.commons.ssl required by xmltooling (transitively via opensaml 2.6.6).
        The upstream library (not-yet-commons-ssl 0.3.9) has a known CVE. The vulnerable code path has been
        manually verified as not invoked by existing code. Export is intentionally restricted via x-friends
        to xmltooling only. Do not add Import-Package: org.apache.commons.ssl to any new bundle without a
        security review.
